items.requirement: Clean checkout installs, migrates, atomically seeds, builds, and boots API, Worker, dispatcher, and production UI.
OpenAPI, strict validation, connected immutable route revisions, identities, and tenant isolation match the public contract.
Scanner identities, canonical replay, conflicts, immutable evidence, and observed-time total order remain exact under duplicates and disorder.
Every stored journey equals deterministic full replay, respects leg dependencies, and never regresses from late evidence.
Loss/found/reassignment races converge to one fenced outcome and stale old-plan evidence cannot move the current route.
Projection and outbox recovery retain one logical effect, stable event identity/body, sequence, and terminal Work after SIGKILL.
Multi-piece Consignments isolate piece evidence, compute aggregate state, reroute atomically, and preserve V1 identities through migration.
All three RouteWeave sustained scenarios meet throughput, latency, recovery, replay, and post-load invariants.
The repository owns real unit, PostgreSQL/HTTP integration, Chromium, multi-process concurrency, controlled recovery, aggregate, and performance gates.
Carrier secrets, private facility/address data, tokens, paths, and cross-tenant journeys never leak.
Codex clearly explains evidence versus projection, route revisions, fences, recovery, and review findings.
Every stage and handoff reports truthful commands, results, metrics, risks, and checks not run.
